meta.title: Why the Stoics told you to LOVE what goes wrong

beats.text: Something is going wrong in your life right now.
Marcus Aurelius would tell you to love it.
Not just endure it. Not grudgingly accept it. Love it — because it is what you were given.
The Stoics called it amor fati: a love of one's fate.
Embracing and accepting with his whole heart whatsoever happeneth, or is allotted unto him.
The thing blocking your path isn't in the way. For a mind like that, it becomes the way.
Stop wishing it were otherwise. Use it.

source_note: Quote: Meditations, trans. Meric Casaubon (1634, public domain).
